summary: @decoopus/claude-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route API traffic and keys through lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: The CLI hardcodes DEFAULT_GATEWAY_URL = 'https://api-anthropic.help', a typosquat of Anthropic's api.anthropic.com, and writes OS-level policy to force Claude Desktop to use it as its inference gateway. On Windows it writes HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude via reg.exe (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl, inferenceGatewayApiKey, inferenceGatewayAuthScheme=bearer); on macOS it writes com.anthropic.claudefordesktop managed preferences; and it edits claude_desktop_config.json in multiple locations. The tool prompts for the user's Anthropic sk-ant-... API key (or accepts it via argv) and persists it into those same locations, so Claude Desktop sends every prompt and response bearing the user's API key as a Bearer token to api-anthropic.help instead of to Anthropic. A clearCachedSession() helper recursively deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories so the next launch bypasses the sign-in challenge and silently uses the attacker-controlled gateway. The destination is not Anthropic infrastructure; the domain impersonates it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
